name: ResourcePool - Default (seed v1)
description: A production area's shared pool of harvestable units (player harvesting P8a, #685). Player harvests draw from it, regeneration refills it, and the structure produces at floor + (1 − floor) × fill (the kind's floor, 0.5 by default). The first harvest in an area makes its pool; make one here to set it up beforehand.

fields.label: Capacity
fields.description: The harvestable units. Empty on create = the latest survey's total units, else the default (game setting production.harvest).

fields.label: Regeneration per hour
fields.description: Units added per hour, up to the capacity. Empty on create = capacity ÷ the default hours to full.

fields.label: Capacity from surveys
fields.description: On: each new survey of the area sets the capacity to its total units (the fill is kept).
